title: Front transformation on encoded triples
statement: For all Boolean words $\alpha,x$ and all $n\in\mathbb{N}$, applying the front transformation to the encoding of $\alpha$, $x$, and a word of $n$ true bits gives the encoding of the pair whose first component is the encoding of the binary representation of $2^n$ together with $\alpha$, and whose second component is $x$; explicitly, $\mathrm{front}(\langle\alpha,\langle x,1^n\rangle\rangle)=\langle\langle\mathrm{bits}(2^n),\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$.
